new_destinations.name: Glenorchy
new_destinations.case: Wikivoyage, DOC and guides treat Glenorchy as its own base, 40 km from Queenstown at the head of the lake, with Paradise, the Greenstone and Caples circuit and the Dart/Rees valleys round it. COVERAGE.md names Glenorchy as separate from Queenstown. Three standalone spots plus the Rees-Dart and Routeburn trailheads would fill a visit.
new_destinations.status: proposal only, needs description, reasons with photos, tips, best months, header. Existing standalone spot 'glenorchy' would then become the destination's namesake (an owner call on id and merging).

new_destination_note: One new destination proposed for the owner: Glenorchy (Paradise, Greenstone and Caples, and the Dart/Rees and Routeburn trailheads cluster round it; Kinloch would join if approved). Its spots are placed as standalone with proposed_destination set so none is lost if the proposal is declined. Wānaka and Lake Wakatipu are destination-scale and are not spots of themselves. No existing destination span needs changing: every destination spot is inside 75% of its span (Hāwea 25.6 of 37.5 km, Rees-Dart 67.5 of 75 km, Macetown 22.4 of 22.5 km are the tight ones).
